turns.assessment: The common failure is lightpath och131 in the S08-to-S15 direction. At onset, its S08 interface raised EQPT_TX_FAIL while the S15 receiver raised OCH_LOS and subsequently lost OSNR, BER validity, and receive power. Channel power was also lost at successive downstream monitors, while all amplifiers remained stable and the S08 interface's receive-side telemetry did not change. This strongly identifies failure of the transmit laser at trx.och131.a rather than a line-system or whole-card failure.

proposals.rationale: The transmitter at S08 explicitly raised EQPT_TX_FAIL exactly when the far-end receiver lost och131. Loss of this channel propagated through downstream OCMs, while amplifier telemetry stayed normal. Stable receive telemetry at the same S08 interface argues against a whole-card failure.
A card failure could remove the transmitted channel, but it should also take down the unit's receive function and silence its monitoring; the S08 receive metrics instead showed no change.
